materials.title_zh: 书评：《灯塔看守人的女儿》
materials.summary_zh: 一篇带讽刺口吻的书评，评论一部虚构的畅销小说。字面上有不少称赞，读懂言外之意才能知道评论者真正的态度。（原创书评，小说为虚构）

segments.en: There is no denying that The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter is a book of considerable length, and its author has clearly never met an adjective she did not like.
segments.zh: 不可否认，《灯塔看守人的女儿》篇幅可观，而作者显然从来没有遇到过她不喜欢的形容词。

segments.en: The sea, we are told on page three, is "restless, brooding and eternally grey", a description that will be repeated, with minor variations, roughly every twenty pages.
segments.zh: 第三页告诉我们，大海“躁动、阴郁、永远灰暗”，这个描写会以细微的变化，大约每二十页重复一次。

segments.en: The heroine, Clara, spends much of the novel gazing out of windows, an activity the author evidently finds more absorbing than some readers will.
segments.zh: 女主人公 Clara 在小说的大部分时间里都在凝望窗外，作者显然觉得这件事比某些读者觉得的更引人入胜。

segments.en: To be fair, the final hundred pages pick up considerably, once a long-buried family secret finally surfaces.
segments.zh: 公平地说，最后一百页节奏明显加快，因为一个埋藏多年的家族秘密终于浮出水面。

segments.en: Whether this reward justifies the four hundred pages that precede it is a question each reader must answer for themselves.
segments.zh: 这份回报是否值得读完前面那四百页，每位读者只能自己回答。

segments.en: The novel has already sold extraordinarily well, which suggests that my reservations are not universally shared.
segments.zh: 这部小说已经卖得极好，这说明我的保留意见并非人人认同。

segments.en: Readers who enjoy atmosphere for its own sake, and who are untroubled by a plot that moves at the pace of the tide, may well find it deeply satisfying.
segments.zh: 喜欢为氛围而氛围、并且不在意情节像潮水一样缓慢推进的读者，很可能会觉得它非常令人满足。

segments.en: Others may wish that the author's editor had been rather less generous with her time, and rather more generous with a red pen.
segments.zh: 其他读者也许会希望作者的编辑少慷慨地给她时间，多慷慨地动用红笔。

glossary.zh: 篇幅可观的（此处暗讽太长）

questions.prompt_zh: “its author has clearly never met an adjective she did not like”暗示什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 字面是“遇到的形容词她都喜欢”，言外之意是形容词用得过多。

questions.prompt_zh: 评论者对女主人公常常凝望窗外的态度是什么？
options: 认为这是全书最精彩的部分
questions.explanation_zh: an activity the author evidently finds more absorbing than some readers will：暗示读者会觉得无聊。

questions.prompt_zh: 评论者承认小说的哪个优点？
options: 最后一百页节奏明显加快
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：To be fair, the final hundred pages pick up considerably ...

questions.prompt_zh: 最后一句关于编辑的话是什么意思？
questions.explanation_zh: less generous with her time, more generous with a red pen：希望编辑多删改，即书太长、太冗余。

materials.summary_zh: 一篇思辨性随笔：在随时可以刷手机的时代，作者认为无聊并非需要消灭的问题，而是创造力和自我反思的条件。（原创随笔）

segments.en: Boredom has acquired a reputation as a minor modern affliction, something to be eliminated as swiftly and efficiently as a headache.
segments.zh: 无聊已经被视为一种轻微的现代病，像头痛一样需要被迅速而高效地消除。

segments.en: And eliminate it we have: the queue, the bus journey and the waiting room, once the natural habitats of boredom, are now lit by the glow of a thousand screens.
segments.zh: 而我们也确实消除了它：排队、坐公交、候诊室，这些曾经是无聊的天然栖息地，如今都被成千上万块屏幕的光照亮。

segments.en: It is worth asking, however, what we have lost in the process, since boredom is not merely the absence of stimulation but a signal that something is missing.
segments.zh: 然而值得一问的是，我们在这个过程中失去了什么，因为无聊不仅仅是缺乏刺激，更是一种“缺少了什么”的信号。

segments.en: Left unanswered for long enough, that signal tends to send the mind wandering, and a wandering mind is remarkably good at making unexpected connections.
segments.zh: 如果足够长时间不去回应这个信号，思绪往往就会游离，而游离的头脑非常擅长建立意想不到的联系。

segments.en: Many people report that their best ideas arrive not at their desks but in the shower or on a long walk, precisely when nothing in particular is demanding their attention.
segments.zh: 很多人说，他们最好的想法不是在办公桌前出现的，而是在洗澡或长时间散步时，恰恰是在没有任何特别的事情需要他们关注的时候。

segments.en: None of this is to romanticise tedium; there is nothing ennobling about a four-hour delay at an airport.
segments.zh: 这么说并不是要美化乏味；在机场延误四个小时没有任何高尚可言。

segments.en: The point is rather that a life in which every empty moment is instantly filled leaves little room for the slow, unstructured thinking from which reflection grows.
segments.zh: 关键在于，如果生活中每个空闲时刻都被立刻填满，那么那种缓慢的、无结构的思考就几乎没有空间，而反思正是从这种思考中生长出来的。

segments.en: Perhaps, then, the most radical thing one can do on the next train journey is to leave the phone in one's pocket and simply look out of the window.
segments.zh: 那么，也许下次坐火车时，一个人能做的最激进的事，就是把手机留在口袋里，只是看着窗外。

glossary.zh: 获得；得到（acquire 的过去分词）

questions.prompt_zh: 第二句“eliminate it we have”说明了什么？
options: 我们已经用屏幕把无聊的时刻都填满了
我们还没有找到消除无聊的办法
公共场所禁止使用手机
questions.explanation_zh: 排队、坐车、候诊这些无聊时刻 now lit by the glow of a thousand screens。

questions.prompt_zh: 作者认为无聊有什么价值？
options: 让思绪游离，产生意想不到的联系
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：a wandering mind is remarkably good at making unexpected connections.

questions.prompt_zh: “None of this is to romanticise tedium”这句话的作用是什么？
options: 预先回应“作者在美化无聊”的质疑
questions.explanation_zh: 作者承认机场延误这种无聊并不美好，以免观点被理解成对乏味的美化。

questions.prompt_zh: 作者最后的建议带有什么语气？
options: 略带幽默地夸大：把普通的事说成“最激进的事”
questions.explanation_zh: the most radical thing ... is to leave the phone in one's pocket：用夸张制造幽默，同时表达观点。

materials.title_en: A Modest Complaint About Smart Homes
materials.title_zh: 关于智能家居的一点小小抱怨
materials.summary_zh: 一段电台幽默专栏：主持人用反讽和轻描淡写讲述自己被“智能”家电折腾的一周。（原创节目）

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.en: This week I finally joined the twenty-first century and made my home smart. I can now report that it is considerably smarter than I am.
segments.zh: 这周我终于跟上了二十一世纪，把家变成了智能家居。现在可以报告：它比我聪明得多。

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.en: The fridge, for instance, now sends me a message whenever we run low on milk, which is thoughtful, if slightly accusatory at six in the morning.
segments.zh: 比如冰箱，现在每当牛奶快没了就给我发消息，很贴心，虽然早上六点收到时略带指责的意味。

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.en: The lights respond to my voice, provided I speak in the calm, clear tone of a newsreader, which is not how I tend to speak when I've just stubbed my toe.
segments.zh: 灯会响应我的声音，前提是我用新闻播音员那种冷静清晰的语气说话，而刚踢到脚趾时我一般可不这么说话。

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.en: On Tuesday, the heating decided, entirely on its own initiative, that I would prefer the house at twenty-eight degrees. It was not entirely wrong, if I'd been a tropical plant.
segments.zh: 周二，暖气完全自作主张，认定我更喜欢家里二十八度。如果我是一株热带植物，它倒也不算全错。

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.en: The doorbell camera has been a particular joy. It now alerts me to every passing cat, delivery van and, on one memorable occasion, a leaf.
segments.zh: 门铃摄像头尤其令人“愉快”。它现在会提醒我每一只路过的猫、每一辆送货车，有一次令人难忘，还提醒了一片树叶。

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.en: My teenage son, naturally, set the whole thing up in about ten minutes and has been quietly enjoying my struggles ever since.
segments.zh: 我那十几岁的儿子，理所当然地，十分钟左右就把整套系统装好了，从那以后一直在默默欣赏我的挣扎。

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.en: I don't want to sound ungrateful. The technology is genuinely impressive, and I'm told it will save energy in the long run.
segments.zh: 我不想显得不知感恩。这项技术确实令人印象深刻，而且据说长远来看能省能源。

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.en: But last night, as I stood in the dark asking a speaker to please, please turn on the kitchen light, I did wonder who was really in charge.
segments.zh: 但昨晚，当我站在黑暗中求一台音箱“拜托，拜托把厨房灯打开”时，我确实忍不住想：到底谁说了算？

glossary.zh: 小小的；不大的（此处为反讽的谦辞）

questions.prompt_zh: 主持人说家“considerably smarter than I am”，语气是什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 说家比自己聪明，是在自嘲被智能设备弄得手忙脚乱。

questions.prompt_zh: 暖气“not entirely wrong, if I'd been a tropical plant”是什么意思？
options: 二十八度对人来说太热了
questions.explanation_zh: 只有热带植物才喜欢这么热，反讽地说温度设得太高。

questions.prompt_zh: “The doorbell camera has been a particular joy”是真心的吗？
options: 不是，它提醒太多，连树叶都报警，很烦人
是，他很喜欢这个摄像头
questions.explanation_zh: a particular joy 是反讽：它连路过的猫和一片树叶都要提醒。

questions.prompt_zh: 主持人最后真正想表达的是什么？
options: 他怀疑自己反而被智能设备控制了
questions.explanation_zh: I did wonder who was really in charge：他觉得自己反倒受设备摆布。他也承认技术确实令人印象深刻。

materials.summary_zh: 一场关于 AI 生成图像的讨论：一位策展人和一位版权律师辩论作者身份、原创性和对艺术家的公平问题。（原创讨论）

segments.speaker: Host
segments.en: An image generated almost entirely by software has just won a regional art prize. Leila, as a curator, were you troubled by that?
segments.zh: 一幅几乎完全由软件生成的图像刚刚赢得了一个地区性艺术奖。Leila，作为策展人，你对此感到不安吗？

segments.speaker: Leila
segments.en: Less by the image than by the silence around it. The entrant didn't disclose how it was made until after the judges had decided.
segments.zh: 让我不安的与其说是图像本身，不如说是围绕它的沉默。参赛者直到评委做出决定后才透露它是怎么做出来的。

segments.speaker: Host
segments.en: So your objection is to the lack of transparency, not to the technology itself?
segments.zh: 所以你反对的是缺乏透明度，而不是技术本身？

segments.speaker: Leila
segments.en: Largely. Artists have always used tools, from the camera onwards. What matters is being honest about which decisions were yours.
segments.zh: 基本上是。艺术家一直在使用工具，从照相机开始就是如此。重要的是诚实说明哪些决定是你自己做的。

segments.speaker: Host
segments.en: Marcus, from a legal point of view, who actually owns an image like this?
segments.zh: Marcus，从法律角度看，这样一幅图像到底归谁所有？

segments.speaker: Marcus
segments.en: That depends heavily on where you are, and in many places the law simply hasn't caught up. Copyright traditionally assumes a human author.
segments.zh: 这在很大程度上取决于你在哪里，而在很多地方，法律根本还没跟上。传统上，版权以人类作者为前提。

segments.speaker: Marcus
segments.en: There's also the uncomfortable question of the millions of existing works these systems learned from, mostly without their creators' consent.
segments.zh: 还有一个令人不安的问题：这些系统学习过的数以百万计的现有作品，大多没有经过创作者同意。

segments.speaker: Leila
segments.en: Which is, to my mind, the real issue. A prize is trivial by comparison with whether working artists can still earn a living.
segments.zh: 在我看来，这才是真正的问题。和职业艺术家还能不能靠创作谋生相比，一个奖项微不足道。

segments.speaker: Marcus
segments.en: I wouldn't call it trivial. Prizes shape careers. But I take the point that the economic question dwarfs the ceremonial one.
segments.zh: 我不会说它微不足道，奖项会影响职业生涯。但我同意，经济问题远比仪式性的问题重大。

segments.speaker: Host
segments.en: So, a qualified yes to the tools, and a firm no to secrecy?
segments.zh: 那么，对工具是有条件的认可，对隐瞒则是坚决反对？

segments.speaker: Leila
segments.en: That would be a fair summary, provided the people whose work trained these systems aren't forgotten.
segments.zh: 这个总结很公允，前提是不要忘了那些作品被用来训练这些系统的人。

glossary.zh: 赶上；跟上（catch up 的过去分词）

questions.prompt_zh: Leila 最不满的是什么？
options: 参赛者在评委决定后才透露作品的制作方式
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：Less by the image than by the silence around it ... didn't disclose how it was made until after the judges had decided.

questions.prompt_zh: Marcus 认为版权问题为什么复杂？
options: 很多地方法律没跟上，传统版权以人类作者为前提
软件公司拥有所有作品
版权法已经明确规定归 AI 所有
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：the law simply hasn't caught up. Copyright traditionally assumes a human author.

questions.prompt_zh: Leila 认为真正的问题是什么？
options: 职业艺术家还能不能靠创作谋生
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：A prize is trivial by comparison with whether working artists can still earn a living.

questions.prompt_zh: Marcus 怎么回应 Leila 说奖项“微不足道”？
options: 不同意奖项微不足道，但同意经济问题更重大
认为奖项是唯一重要的问题
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I wouldn't call it trivial ... But I take the point that the economic question dwarfs the ceremonial one.

materials.summary_zh: 一篇随笔：每代人都怀念过去；怀旧作为私人慰藉有其价值，变成公共政策时却需要警惕。

segments.en: Every generation, it seems, is convinced that it grew up at the precise moment when things began to go downhill: when music lost its soul, children lost their manners and conversation gave way to whatever device happened to be fashionable.
segments.zh: 似乎每一代人都坚信，自己恰好成长在一切开始走下坡路的那一刻：音乐失去了灵魂，孩子失去了礼貌，交谈让位给了当时恰好流行的某种设备。

segments.en: The complaint is so reliable that one could almost set a calendar by it.
segments.zh: 这种抱怨如此准时，几乎可以拿它来校准日历。

segments.en: Nostalgia is not, of course, simply a failure of memory.
segments.zh: 当然，怀旧并不只是记忆出了问题。

segments.en: Psychologists suggest that it serves a genuine purpose, lending a sense of continuity to lives that might otherwise feel fragmented, and that people who indulge in it occasionally report feeling less lonely afterwards.
segments.zh: 心理学家认为，它确有其用：为可能显得支离破碎的人生带来一种延续感；偶尔沉浸其中的人事后会觉得没那么孤独。

segments.en: The trouble begins when this private comfort is promoted to public policy.
segments.zh: 麻烦始于这种私人的慰藉被提升为公共政策的时候。

segments.en: Politicians who promise to restore a lost golden age are rarely specific about which year they have in mind, and for good reason.
segments.zh: 那些承诺恢复失落黄金时代的政客，很少具体说明他们指的是哪一年，而且理由很充分。

segments.en: Closer inspection tends to reveal that the golden age was considerably less golden for anyone who was not young, healthy and comfortably off at the time.
segments.zh: 仔细一看就会发现，对于当时不年轻、不健康、不宽裕的人来说，那个黄金时代远没有那么金光闪闪。

segments.en: None of this means the past has nothing to teach us.
segments.zh: 这一切并不意味着过去没有什么可教我们的。

segments.en: But a past worth learning from has to be remembered accurately, inconvenient details included, rather than curated like a museum gift shop.
segments.zh: 但值得借鉴的过去必须被准确地记住，包括那些令人不快的细节，而不是像博物馆礼品店那样精心挑选陈列。

glossary.zh: 拿……来校准日历（形容极其准时、可预测）

glossary.note_zh: lend a sense of … to … = 给……增添一种……感

glossary.zh: 令人不便的；令人不快的

questions.prompt_zh: 第一段说每一代人都坚信什么？
options: 自己恰好成长在一切开始变糟的时候
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：it grew up at the precise moment when things began to go downhill.

questions.prompt_zh: 心理学家认为怀旧有什么作用？
options: 给人生带来延续感，偶尔沉浸其中会减少孤独
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：lending a sense of continuity … people who indulge in it occasionally report feeling less lonely.

questions.prompt_zh: 作者为什么说政客不说明是哪一年“理由很充分”？
options: 仔细看会发现那个时代对很多人并不美好
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：the golden age was considerably less golden for anyone who was not young, healthy and comfortably off.

questions.prompt_zh: 作者对怀旧的最终态度是：
options: 可以向过去学习，但必须准确记住，包括不光彩的细节
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：a past worth learning from has to be remembered accurately, inconvenient details included.

materials.summary_zh: 一篇讽刺专栏：作者读遍效率书、用尽各种方法，最后发现最有效的技巧是说“不”。

segments.en: I have read every book on productivity published in the last decade, which, given how many there are, may be the least productive thing I have ever done.
segments.zh: 过去十年出版的每一本关于效率的书我都读过——考虑到这类书有多少，这可能是我做过的最没效率的事。

segments.en: I have colour-coded my calendar, batched my emails, eaten the frog first thing in the morning and, on one memorable occasion, scheduled fifteen minutes for spontaneity.
segments.zh: 我给日历做过颜色分类，把邮件集中处理，一大早先啃最难的骨头，还有一次令人难忘的经历：给“随性而为”安排了十五分钟。

segments.en: My to-do lists have to-do lists.
segments.zh: 我的待办清单还有自己的待办清单。

segments.en: And yet, somewhere between optimising my morning routine and tracking my sleep to the minute, I began to suspect that the systems had become the work.
segments.zh: 然而，在优化晨间习惯、把睡眠精确记录到分钟的某个时刻，我开始怀疑这些系统本身已经变成了工作。

segments.en: The industry is built on a flattering premise: that the reason we feel overwhelmed is a lack of technique, rather than the simple fact that we have agreed to do too much.
segments.zh: 这个行业建立在一个讨人喜欢的前提之上：我们之所以不堪重负，是因为缺乏技巧，而不是因为我们简单地答应了太多事情。

segments.en: A better app is always easier to sell than a shorter list.
segments.zh: 一个更好的应用，总比一张更短的清单好卖。

segments.en: I have not abandoned my calendar, which remains as colourful as ever.
segments.zh: 我并没有放弃我的日历，它依然五彩缤纷。

segments.en: But I have started, tentatively, to practise the one technique none of the books recommended with much enthusiasm: saying no, and then doing nothing in particular with the time I have saved.
segments.zh: 但我已经开始小心翼翼地练习一种没有哪本书热情推荐过的技巧：说“不”，然后用省下来的时间什么特别的事也不做。

segments.en: So far, the results are promising, although I have not yet found a way to measure them.
segments.zh: 到目前为止，效果令人满意，尽管我还没找到衡量它的方法。

glossary.zh: 先做最难、最不想做的事
讨人喜欢的；令人受用的

questions.prompt_zh: 作者说读完所有效率书“可能是最没效率的事”，这是：
options: 自嘲：这类书太多，读完本身就很浪费时间
questions.explanation_zh: 原文：given how many there are, may be the least productive thing I have ever done.

questions.prompt_zh: “My to-do lists have to-do lists.”想表达什么？
options: 他的计划系统已经复杂到荒谬的程度
questions.explanation_zh: 夸张的说法，讽刺自己的计划系统层层叠叠、过于复杂。

materials.title_en: The Myth of the Untranslatable Word
materials.summary_zh: 一篇随笔：作者认为“不可译词”清单虽然迷人，却夸大了语言之间的隔阂。

segments.en: Few things delight language enthusiasts more than a list of 'untranslatable' words: a German term for the pleasure of someone else's misfortune, a Portuguese word for a longing that may never be satisfied, a Japanese expression for light filtering through leaves.
segments.zh: 很少有什么比一张“不可译词”清单更让语言爱好者开心的了：一个表示幸灾乐祸的德语词，一个表示也许永远无法满足的思念的葡萄牙语词，一个形容阳光透过树叶洒落的日语表达。

segments.en: Such lists are charming, and they make a reasonable point: languages carve up experience in different ways, and some concepts are more readily available in one than another.
segments.zh: 这类清单很迷人，也说出了一个合理的观点：不同语言以不同方式切分经验，有些概念在某种语言中比在另一种语言中更容易表达。

segments.en: Where they go wrong is in the leap from 'there is no single English word for this' to 'English speakers cannot grasp this feeling'.
segments.zh: 它们出错的地方在于，从“英语里没有一个单词能表达这个”一下子跳到了“说英语的人无法理解这种感受”。

segments.en: The very fact that the list can explain each word in a sentence or two rather undermines its own claim.
segments.zh: 这份清单能用一两句话解释每个词，这一事实本身就相当削弱了它自己的说法。

segments.en: What is genuinely difficult to translate is rarely an isolated word; it is the web of associations, rhythms and assumptions that surround it, which no dictionary entry, however clever, can fully carry across.
segments.zh: 真正难以翻译的很少是一个孤立的词，而是围绕着它的那张由联想、节奏和预设织成的网，任何词典词条，无论多么巧妙，都无法完全传达过去。

segments.en: A translator of poetry knows this intimately, and spends her working life making compromises that no list will ever celebrate.
segments.zh: 诗歌译者对此再熟悉不过，她的整个职业生涯都在做出一些永远不会被任何清单称颂的妥协。

segments.en: Perhaps we should retire the word 'untranslatable' and speak instead of the 'not yet translated': a humbler phrase, admittedly, but one that leaves room for the patient work of bringing languages closer together.
segments.zh: 也许我们应该让“不可译”这个词退休，改说“尚未译出”：诚然，这个说法更谦逊，但它为让语言彼此靠近的耐心工作留出了空间。

materials.title_en: Letter to the Editor: A Thorough Consultation
materials.title_zh: 致编辑的信：一次“彻底”的意见征询
materials.summary_zh: 一封读者来信：表面上称赞市政府的公园意见征询，字里行间全是讽刺。（虚构）

segments.en: Sir, I was delighted to read that the council's consultation on the future of Hartley Park attracted 'an unprecedented level of engagement'.
segments.zh: 编辑先生：读到市政府关于哈特利公园未来的意见征询吸引了“前所未有的参与度”，我非常高兴。

segments.en: As one of the four hundred residents who attended the public meeting, I can confirm that engagement was indeed unprecedented, if by engagement one means people standing in the corridor because the room booked for the occasion held thirty.
segments.zh: 作为参加公开会议的四百名居民之一，我可以证实参与度确实前所未有——如果所谓“参与”指的是人们站在走廊里，因为为此预订的房间只能容纳三十人的话。

segments.en: I was particularly impressed by the efficiency of the process.
segments.zh: 我对整个流程的效率尤其印象深刻。

segments.en: The consultation opened on a Friday afternoon in August, closed nine days later, and the council's report, published the following morning, concluded that residents broadly supported the plan to sell the eastern half of the park to developers.
segments.zh: 征询在八月的一个周五下午开始，九天后结束，而市政府的报告在第二天上午就发布了，结论是居民大体支持把公园东半部分卖给开发商的计划。

segments.en: That the report ran to sixty pages suggests either remarkable diligence or that it had been written somewhat in advance.
segments.zh: 报告长达六十页，这要么说明了非凡的勤奋，要么说明它是提前写好的。

segments.en: I would not wish to accuse anyone of predetermining the outcome.
segments.zh: 我可不想指责任何人预先定好了结果。

segments.en: I merely note that the questionnaire offered three options, 'strongly support', 'support' and 'support with minor reservations', which some residents felt did not fully capture the range of local opinion.
segments.zh: 我只是注意到，问卷提供了三个选项——“强烈支持”“支持”和“支持但略有保留”——一些居民认为这并不能完全反映当地意见的范围。

segments.en: I look forward to the next consultation, and will bring a chair.
segments.zh: 我期待着下一次征询，并打算自带椅子。

segments.en: Yours faithfully, M. Okafor
segments.zh: M. 奥卡福 谨上
